notes.title: Minor update
notes.content:
Changed the materials on buildings for all levels
 Moved stuff around in Level 4

notes.title: Enabled Vsync & the ability to Switch between Windowed Fullscreen/Windowed
notes.content:
Enabled Vsync
 Added a "Checkmark" box where you can switch between "Windowed Fullscreen" & "Windowed", it's not perfect but it should work ok

notes.title: Input changes, Secondary Target functionality and visual updates to Levels
notes.content:
Inputs has changed slightly!

 The character now auto runs
 You now need to hold a specific input to walk
 The input to slide has changed as well
 Using the Camera Flash has changed input location



New Tutorial Level!

 After feedback, the tutorial has changed from a linear-ish level to a more "free-form" level where you can explore the game's mechanics a bit more
 Besides, the previous level had some issues with assets loading in that caused some initial hiccups 



Taking pictures of "Secondary Targets"

 Has changed name to "Clue(s)" instead
 Outside the "tutorial level", taking pictures of the "Clues" now adds some time to the game timer
 Instead of randomly choosing a "mesh" when the game starts, "Clue(s)" now will have (depending on the level) a dedicated mesh & color depending on the level and area of the level



Levels

 All levels had some visual updates to the sky
 Adjusting the placements of certain level meshes

notes.title: Gamepad Look "Force"
notes.content: Changed the multiplier for the player's look "force" on Gamepad

notes.title: Changes to Secondary Target, looking around inputs & changes to level 1
notes.content:
Secondary Targets are now created with a random material
 Depending on your preferred input, looking around adjusts accordingly
 Level 1 is now hopefully a little bit easier

notes.title: Updated the tutorial level
notes.content: Removed some ramps in the tutorial level

notes.title: Updated some levels & added hints to the User Interface
notes.content:
Updated the following levels:
- Tutorial Level: Added a "Secondary Target" that the player can take a picture of
- Level 1: Made parts of the level a little bit safer
- Level 2: Moved a "Secondary Target" to be more visible

Updated UI:
- There's now iconography to hint towards the player what input to use for taking pictures & using the camera flash
